text:
```yaml
name: Format

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@v1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --check
```
